name: Threshold lock (who's in)
use_when: a plan happens only if enough people commit: '3 of 4 in', 'need 4 for the airbnb'
headcount for one event, concert, trip or game
'who's in', 'are we doing this', 'rsvp', 'count me in'
guarantees: each person has one answer: going, maybe or no
the plan locks exactly when going reaches the threshold and never unlocks
the threshold follows the chat (0 means everyone) and is never more than the chat size
a leaver's answer goes; a late joiner is waiting like everyone else

title.description: The plan, short, e.g. 'SZA on Saturday'

detail.description: Where and when if known, e.g. 'Kia Forum · Sat 8 PM', else empty

need.description: How many going locks it; the number from the chat, or 0 for everyone in the chat (0 follows the chat as people join or leave)
